rows.note: An HRESULT's fields: a severity, four flags, an 11-bit facility and a 16-bit code.

rows.name: SEVERITY
rows.note: 1 for a failure

rows.name: RESERVED
rows.note: the R bit: reserved, but for a few NTSTATUS-mapped codes

rows.name: CUSTOMER
rows.note: the C bit: a code a customer defined

rows.name: NTSTATUS
rows.note: the N bit: an NTSTATUS, mapped to an HRESULT

rows.name: X
rows.note: the X bit: reserved, and set by the DirectX facilities, whose numbers reach it

rows.name: FACILITY
rows.note: who defined the code

FACILITY_DIRECT3D10.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_DIRECT3D10 (0x879: the X bit, with facility 0x79)

FACILITY_DXGI.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_DXGI (0x87A: the X bit, with facility 0x7A)

FACILITY_DXGI_DDI.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_DXGI_DDI (0x87B: the X bit, with facility 0x7B)

FACILITY_DIRECT3D11.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_DIRECT3D11 (0x87C: the X bit, with facility 0x7C)

FACILITY_DIRECT3D12.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_DIRECT3D12 (0x87E: the X bit, with facility 0x7E)

FACILITY_WINCODEC_ERR.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_WINCODEC_ERR (0x898: the X bit, with facility 0x98)

FACILITY_D2D.note: the Windows SDK's FACILITY_D2D (0x899: the X bit, with facility 0x99)

rows.name: CODE
rows.note: the code, within its facility
